text: Look at the cherry blossoms! We get to see them in\nfull bloom again this year!\nLet's start getting ready for our hanami picnic!
Huh? That's Mt. Hazakura, isn't it?\nThe cherry blossoms over there are much better\nthan the ones around here!
I wonder how Princess Nanaka is doing~.
Maybe we should have our hanami picnic at\nMt. Hazakura this year!\nLet's go check it out!
